authorization: Operator-set active goal: one actual protocol, at most two primary sources, independent pair-coherence identification and unused-response validation without modifying P1/PAH/EXCH.
question: Does the actual prepared state and calibrated readout independently identify the pair quadrature controlling exchange and predict a response setting not used for fitting, with controlled uncertainty?
protocol: Donley85Rb two magnetic pulses separated by a fixed-field evolution interval; pulse2 followed by field ramp, expansion, release and destructive absorption imaging. Source actual state/control/detector, not an ideal pi/2 two-mode replacement.

scope.TECT: P1/PAH/EXCH sources preserved. EXCH fixed side16 periodic T3, Q11008/27, each fixed K>=1 and original Hamiltonian tau remain reference-only for this measurement audit.
scope.physical: One native85Rb protocol with actual shot-number noise, trapped inhomogeneous gas, bound/continuum/remnant channels and laboratory time. Not mapped to the full three-Psi/chi EXCH state by assertion.
scope.target: Invariant pair correlation C relative to a fixed current-generating coupling g; physical flux depends on Im(g*C). ImC alone requires an independently anchored convention for g.
scope.measurement: All calibrated analyzer endpoint probabilities may be used. Population-time differentiation or fitting the same unknown phase cannot define the independent target.
scope.limits: Only source-declared finite experimental intervals. No thermodynamic, continuum, cutoff or long-time limit; no fitted tau conversion.

required_before_physical_reconstruction: Source-native pair observable/normalization and preparation class, including initial number variation
Complete pulse2-to-detector instrument effects anchored relative to the conversion coupling, with continuum/population nuisance and survival normalization handled
Calibration, joint shot-noise covariance, phase/error bounds, loss, backaction/control work and valid finite time window
A frozen unused-for-fitting setting with separately supplied outcome counts and uncertainty

role_freeze.timing: Exact source versions and roles fixed before reference-verifier execution; source passages and published outcomes were already inspected during intake. No physical parameter fitting or source-data prediction has run.
role_freeze.policy: Do not estimate an analyzer phase from either published response and call it independent quadrature calibration. If the instrument/error packet is absent, report NOT_EXECUTED and HOLD, not an invented numerical prediction.

diagnostic_plan: Use source full-channel effect E=U2_dagger M U2 including post-pulse detection operations, rather than replace the native protocol with a qubit.
Check target-functional identifiability by annihilation of the measurement nullspace, including known population constraints; full tomography is not required if the one target is identifiable.

Use two-channel matrices only as labelled conditional algebra/oracle controls. Keep current coupling fixed in unknown-analyzer-phase witnesses; joint state/coupling basis rephasing is not a physical obstruction.
Propagate covariance symbolically only under independent effect/noise assumptions; do not fill missing experimental error matrices with zero.
Independent and hostile source/code checks; exactly one PASS/DISPROVED/HOLD decision, no automatic successor.
pass: Source-native independent target reconstruction and an unused-for-fitting response verified within an actual justified joint error bound, all required inputs filled.
disproved: An exact contradiction for the specified native instrument/state class, not a conditional qubit ambiguity or lack of published data.
hold: One missing calibrated source-native analyzer-and-outcome packet prevents reconstruction or validation; preserve the residual question, not another equivalent finite calculation.
non_claims: No new model, EXCH quantization, ideal-pulse insertion, damping/time law, physical clock, full P1 identity, PreA, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass gap or TOE.
